expr: (let ((re (regexp-opt (list "ab") (quote words)))) (list (string-match re "x ab y") (match-end 0) (match-string 1 "x ab y") (string-match re "xaby")))
note: PAREN `words'. Emacs answers (2 4 "ab" nil): the wrapper is \\< ... \\> around a CAPTURING group, so group 1 is still the match, the span over "x ab y" is the word itself at 2..4 -- the boundaries are ZERO-WIDTH and are not part of it -- and the same member no longer matches inside "xaby". That last nil is the whole point of the value: it changes what matches, not just how it is grouped. kg answers `wrong-number-of-arguments' at this pin, and its engine has no \\< / \\> either, so this value costs more than the wrapper.
